title: How Many Use The $20 Plan vs $100 Plan And Credits?
author: bingewavecinema
selftext:
I wish there was still poling on reddit...

Claude and Codex offer the $20 plans  and the $100 plans. To develop your games, I wanted to see how many subscribe to each plan and do you also pay for extra credits?

  
Anonymous Poll Here:

[https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSee88UGBCNkyVsIFa6YN6f8aFtjgE057l0vAVJX9xPVYcgJ8A/viewform?usp=header](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSee88UGBCNkyVsIFa6YN6f8aFtjgE057l0vAVJX9xPVYcgJ8A/viewform?usp=header)

  
I'll results.

comments.author: umhassy
comments.body: you can just do pulls in reddit. duh.

replies.author: bingewavecinema
replies.body: I don't see it in their new interfance

comments.author: Ok-Investment4414
comments.body: best thing is waiting 5 months then get a 100 plan

replies.author: Ok-Investment4414
replies.body: 20 plan good for like 3 - 4 prompts per 5hrs

replies.author: Ray_Light91
replies.body:
That fully depends on the complextity of your code as well as how clean your codebase is. Messy codebase means more tokens wasted due too too many non-important things being read and stored.

Time for some refactoring?

Or the requests are long and tedious, that's also an option😅

comments.author: Disposable110
comments.body:
Codex $20 is enough for like 3-4 hours of work per 8 hour limit cycle on medium, $100 never runs out in any average use case.

Claude constantly runs out.

I've got some local Qwen model (27B) running that the big model can delegate easy tasks to and that's going well.

replies.author: purpleburgundy
replies.body: Credit burn rate depends what models you're using. I find codex/gpt5 and claude/sonnet46 are pretty similar

replies.author: mallcopsarebastards
replies.body: I use claude code with a max sub with opus, I am always using it. 8 hours a day. I've never run out.

comments.author: BoltVnderhuge
comments.body: Claude pro gets me 10\~12 hours of game dev per week. I also use pixel lab for generating art

comments.author: Professional_Job_307
comments.body: I dont do much gamedev, but using Codex for coding and a Plus sub is barely enough so I just have 2 Plus subs and I never run out. Having extra also lets me just hammer the thing on anything i want without worrying about usage. Great peace of mind.

replies.author: Ray_Light91
replies.body: The only annoying thing there is switching between both all the time.

replies.author: Professional_Job_307
replies.body: Yeah i wish they made that easier, like the account switcher in chatgpt.

comments.author: No-Trouble-9138
comments.body: $20 works if you do part of the programming yourself. I leave the tedious boilerplate stuff to Claude, then I continue with improvements, fixes, debugging.

comments.author: zenmatrix83
comments.body: for codex and claude any extra credits that equal a sub increase is better to just increase the subscription. github I think at this point is 1x-2x just like cursor for api rates. Last time I looked claude code according to ccusuage was like 10-30x api costs, just the rate limits hit your. I think codex is similar, you can get quite alot done on codex but I haven't used it since I just standardized on claude code with a higher sub level

comments.author: lemonlemons
comments.body: I currently have 20$ plans for both claude and codex. I constantly run out of usage with both, but I do get lot done as well. Would be much more fun with 200$ subscriptions, but as this is just a hobby for me, haven’t gone there yet.

comments.author: postdevs
comments.body:
I get the $100 Codex one.  The $20 would work if I was willing to be patient sometimes.   With the $100 I can just run it on fast/extra high for the 4 hours or so a day that I work on my game and never worry about it. 

12+ years as a web dev.  It's honestly incredible how well it does.

comments.author: blessed--
comments.body: people with $100 plans are not going to be here crying to the poors lmao, they'll be using their plans

comments.author: Charming-Author4877
comments.body:
You can't do much with the 20$ plan. That's for occasional tasks.  
Like annoying refactors, changing or searching code, running benchmarks and tests.

The 100$ plan is enough for higher intensity workloads, but only the 200$ plan feels like you've enough if you use AI a lot. With 100$ you'll be chasing one "free" reset after another

comments.author: Ok-Investment4414
comments.body: chat gpt can give you more code for your $20 , just ask it to generate the code and u assemble it

comments.author: under_the_sun11
comments.body: Claude is a psyop. Just use Cursor Pro+, I've never used up the entire $60 plan.

comments.author: Accomplished-Read965
comments.body: I use Claude Pro. Since I'm using it after work and not full time, this would be enough in theory. I never use up my weekly contingent. But the 5h windows sucks when I actually have time at the weekends where I burn through the 5h contingent after at max 2h :(. Wish there was a middle ground...
